reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual third-round review of external-03 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 06 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged full native RGBA raw, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; earlier review files were left unchanged

entries.positive_observation: External-03 restores the high receding hairline with very short dark-brown crown and side hair and restores distinct dark eyebrows on the yellow mascot. The face has one restrained closed mouth, a smooth chin and no glasses, moustache or beard. The nearly frontal slightly viewer-left pose, chest-up crop and directional cheek modeling remain. The dark olive uniform retains red/gold collar patches, gold shoulder trim, one pale blue-white ribbon and one silver-toned cross pendant. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk, clipping or cream bib. The note has exactly two compact upper gray-mark rows with two small groups per row, no third row or lower-left dash, and largely blank lower paper. The complete dark tilted frame, opaque gray-olive photographic backing, cream note and right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the native RGBA transparent exterior outside the complete frame/note silhouette. Actual white/cyan/alpha inspection found no visible holes or missing backing; 252-254 alpha values were not used as a rejection shortcut. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: Exact collar/pendant symbols, the finest hairline pixels and note glyph identity are not reliably readable at 65x67. Visible hair, eyebrows, clothing counts and the two-by-two compact note-mark layout were checked directly rather than inferred from those unreadable details.
